# AI PR Review Rules: dispatch

Repository-specific security and compact-review guidance lives in the trusted-base skills:
- [.agents/skills/dispatch-security-review/SKILL.md](../.agents/skills/dispatch-security-review/SKILL.md)
- [.agents/skills/dispatch-worker-contract/SKILL.md](../.agents/skills/dispatch-worker-contract/SKILL.md)

The native reviewer catalogs .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md when repository-skills: "true" is enabled. Read the relevant skill for API/auth, Prisma, webhook, queue, task-reporting, or worker-lifecycle changes. AGENTS.md remains the general project guide.
